Name: (CP) Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Craftables
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Updated for 1.6, now with nearly 60 items![/b]

[/size]Replaces craftables with a rich burnt sienna and gold palette, akin to the chest you find in the mines. Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687/]Eemie's Darker Wood and Gold Craftables~[/url]

This mod edits the following items:
Anvil, Auto-Grabber, Auto-Petter, Bait Maker, Bee House, Bone Mill, Barrel Brazier, Stump Brazier, Carved Brazier, Wooden Brazier, Campfire, Cask, Charcoal Kiln, Cheese Press, Chest, Big Chest, Stone Chest, Big Stone Chest, Coffee Maker, Cookout Kit, Crystalarium, Dehydrator, Farm Computer, Fish Smoker, Furnace, Heavy Furnace, Garden Pots, Geode Crusher, Hopper, Jukebox, Keg, Wood Lamp, Iron Lamp, Lightning Rod, Loom, Mayo Maker, Mini Obelisk, Mini Shipping Bin, Mushroom Box, Mushroom Log, Oil Maker, Ostrich Incubator, Preserves Jar, Recycling Machine, Seed Maker, Sewing Machine, Wood Sign, Stone Sign, Text Sign, Solar Panel, Statue of Blessings, Statue of the Dwarf King, Tapper, Heavy Tapper, Tub 'o Flowers, Wood Chipper, Worm Bin, Deluxe Worm Bin, and Workbench.

After install, use the config to pick and choose your preferred items! 
NOTE: Mini Shipping Bin is set to false by default, for compatibility with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1904]Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Shipping Bin and Mailbox[/url] mod.

Any more items you'd like to see with this color palette? Leave a comment on this mod, or send me a DM and I'll make an update!

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25655]For the Alternative Textures version, go here![/url][/b]

[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using Notepad++ or program of your choice) to choose your desired items.
All items are set to "true" by default, except the Mini Shipping Bin at "false".
Alternatively, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu﻿[/url] to make your choice in-game. (recommended)
4. Load up your game and enjoy!



[/font][font=Tahoma]OG Content Patcher version thanks to finduilan and m2pt5!
